blogger-goGo SDK for Blogger API v3

Complete client covering all 8 resources and 33 methods. Builder pattern, typed errors, pagination helpers, OAuth2.

Get Started
View on GitHub

Complete API Coverage

All 8 resources and 33 methods from the canonical discovery document (revision 20260924).

Builder Pattern

Chainable request construction with per-service option helpers.

Typed Errors

Structured APIError with HTTP code, message, and per-reason details.

Pagination Helpers

Cursor-based pagination with Token, PaginationResult, and an automatic page walker.

OAuth2 Ready

Token source helpers on top of golang.org/x/oauth2 and official Google auth options.

Context Propagation

Every method takes context.Context first, so cancellation and deadlines just work.
